title: SAC Front-End / UX Developer
description:
**Swiss Delivery Excellence: Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.**

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

Focused on S4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.

Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision-making, our client-first and open-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality.

**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced
**SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Front-End / UX Developer**
to design, develop, and enhance intuitive, user-friendly planning applications and interfaces within SAP Analytics Cloud. The role focuses on creating interactive dashboards, planning interfaces, and analytical applications that support business planning, forecasting, and reporting processes. Working closely with functional consultants, back-end developers, and business stakeholders, the developer ensures seamless user experiences, efficient application performance, and alignment with business requirements and UX best practices.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain SAP Analytics Cloud applications, planning interfaces, and interactive dashboards.
* Build intuitive and responsive user interfaces using SAC Stories, Analytics Designer capabilities, and scripting functionalities.
* Develop and enhance planning applications, including input forms, interactive tables, filters, and navigation components.
* Implement custom application logic, JavaScript-based scripting, and interactive functionalities within SAC.
* Collaborate with SAC back-end developers to integrate planning models, calculations, and data actions into front-end applications.
* Translate business requirements and user feedback into functional, visually appealing, and efficient UX solutions.
* Optimize application performance, usability, and responsiveness across different user scenarios.
* Troubleshoot front-end issues, improve existing applications, and implement enhancements based on business needs.
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT), technical documentation, deployment, and ongoing application improvements.

**Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), particularly application development, visualization, and planning interfaces.
* Proven experience developing SAC Stories, analytical applications, dashboards, and interactive planning solutions.
* Solid understanding of SAC Analytics Designer capabilities, application scripting, and JavaScript.
* Experience designing user-friendly interfaces, navigation structures, and interactive components within SAC.
* Knowledge of SAC Planning functionalities, including planning tables, data actions, version management, and input controls.
* Understanding of UI/UX design principles, usability standards, and responsive application development.
* Experience integrating front-end SAC applications with planning models and SAP back-end data sources.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization skills.
* Ability to collaborate with technical teams, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to deliver effective planning applications.

**Additional Information**

**Why Fusion?**

At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients.

We value employees who challenge the status quo through innovation, adapt to diverse client needs in ever-changing environments, and commit to continuous learning—for themselves and their colleagues.

We provide a competitive salary and benefits package, along with an outstanding work environment that fosters long-term career development opportunities.

**Our Benefits:**

* **Workflex:**
  Enjoy 25 days of flexibility to work from your preferred global location.
* **Flexible Time Off:**
  Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance, with flexibility beyond standard holiday allowances.
* **Annual Training Budget:**
  Access CHF 1,500 to invest in your professional development and skill enhancement.
* **Continuous Learning:**
  Thrive in an environment that encourages ongoing learning, with opportunities to develop new skills and broaden your expertise.
* **Global Mobility Support:**
  Gain assistance with international assignments, visa/permit support, and relocation services.
* **Unity Scheme:**
  Benefit from loyalty rewards starting after 3 years of service.
* **Referral Program:**
  Earn a referral fee for every successfully hired referee.
* **Local Benefits:**
  Access a range of country-specific benefits tailored to your location.
* **People Focus:**
  Unite with the best global talent in life sciences, empowered to grow and collaborate in a vibrant environment.
* **Truly Global:**
  Join a truly global organization where mutual support, teamwork, and diversity drive our collective success.

title: Intern- Zoetis Tech & Digital
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

Zoetis India Capability Center (ZICC) in Hyderabad, where innovation meets excellence. As part of the world's leading animal healthcare company, ZICC is at the forefront of driving transformative advancements and applying technology to solve the most complex problems. Our mission is to ensure sustainable growth and maintain a competitive edge for Zoetis globally by leveraging the exceptional talent in India. At ZICC, you'll be part of a dynamic team that partners with colleagues worldwide, embodying the true spirit of One Zoetis. Together, we ensure seamless integration and collaboration, fostering an environment where your contributions can make a real impact. Be a part of our journey to pioneer innovation and drive the future of animal healthcare. We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Intern to join our team. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience, learn industry best practices, and contribute to meaningful projects that impact the organization.
  
  
**Title**
: Intern- Zoetis Tech & Digital
  
**Location**
: Hyderabad
  
**Duration**
: 6 months (Jan 2027- Jun 2027)
  
**Mode of Working**
: In - office

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Pursuing B.tech (4th Year, 2nd Semester) in Computer Science / IT or related field. Strong understanding of any programming language and OOP concepts. Basic knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). Familiarity with databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and version control tools (Git). Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and in a team environment. Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

**Job Description**

* + Develop, test, and deploy scalable web applications across the stack Front-end: React or Vue
  + Back-end: Node.js/Express or Python/Java
  + APIs: REST and/or GraphQL

Ensure application performance, security, reliability, and basic observability (logs/metrics)

* + Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code; follow version control best practices (Git)
  + Conduct and participate in code reviews; troubleshoot and fix issues across the stack
  + Build Python scripts to automate tasks, clean/transform data, and create simple utilities
  + Query, transform, and validate datasets using SQL (joins, aggregations, data quality checks)
  + Assist with data analysis, reporting, and lightweight dashboards
  + Document code, queries, and processes; contribute to basic testing (unit/integration)
  + Collaborate with product, design, and engineering stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver actionable outputs

**Nice to Have (Optional)**

* + Exposure to data visualization (e.g., matplotlib) and basic CI workflows

**Notes**

* + Cloud experience is not required
  + General internship; not tied to a specific team or product

Incumbent may be asked to perform other duties as required. Additional position specific requirements/responsibilities are contained in approved training curricula*

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (TypeScript / JavaScript)
description:
**Company Description**
HUNOVO Tech Labs is a technology-focused organization dedicated to building high-quality, scalable software solutions for clients across diverse industries. The company emphasizes modern engineering practices, collaborative problem-solving, and close partnerships with stakeholders to deliver impactful products. Teams at HUNOVO Tech Labs work with contemporary web technologies and cloud-native tools to address complex business challenges. The culture supports continuous learning, experimentation, and ownership of outcomes, making it a strong environment for engineers who enjoy working close to end users.

**Build. Deploy. Solve Real Problems.**

**We're looking for a curious, hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer**

who wants to build software that solves real-world problems and reaches production quickly.

This role is for engineers who enjoy working across the stack, getting close to how systems actually work, and turning ideas into reliable solutions. You'll work through the entire engineering lifecycle—from understanding problems and designing solutions to coding, reviewing, testing, deploying, and iterating.

You'll also work with AI-powered development tools, using them to accelerate delivery while applying your own engineering judgment to validate code, identify risks, and ensure quality.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build and ship:**

  Develop production-ready features using TypeScript and JavaScript across the stack.
* **Solve real-world problems:**

  Translate requirements and practical challenges into working software solutions.
* **Own the development lifecycle:**

  Participate in design, implementation, code review, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.
* **Work with data:**

  Write, optimize, and troubleshoot SQL queries against real-world datasets.
* **Review code critically:**

  Evaluate human-written and AI-generated code for correctness, architecture, maintainability, performance, and security.
* **Debug systematically:**

  Investigate failures, understand error messages, trace issues to their root causes, and implement reliable fixes.
* **Collaborate and iterate:**

  Work closely with teammates to deliver solutions quickly without compromising engineering fundamentals.

**What We're Looking For**

* **TypeScript / JavaScript​:**

  Strong fundamentals, including async/await, promises, and using types to design reliable systems.
* **SQL:**

  Hands-on experience writing queries, using joins, understanding indexes, and identifying performance bottlenecks.
* **Git:**

  Comfortable with branches, commits, merge vs. rebase, reading diffs, and resolving conflicts.
* **HTTP & REST APIs:**

  Understanding of request/response flows, status codes, authentication headers, and API integration.
* **Engineering judgment:**

  Ability to test your code, verify assumptions, interpret errors, and explain why your solution works.
* **Code review mindset:**

  Willingness to challenge code including AI-generated code and identify potential architectural, delivery, and security issues.
* **Learning agility:**

  Strong fundamentals, curiosity, independent research skills, and a willingness to take ownership of unfamiliar problems.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience shipping projects in Java, Python, Go, or other programming languages.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants and AI-driven development workflows.
* Personal projects, open-source contributions, or applications you've built and deployed.
* Experience integrating APIs, debugging production issues, or working directly with users to understand their needs.

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations will play a critical role in building and operating the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience end-to-end.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations to build, operate, and continuously improve the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience — including product and catalog workflows, cart and checkout, order processing, account management, and the internal tools our operations teams rely on every day. This is a full-stack role with real end-to-end ownership spanning application development, APIs and integrations, data processing, cloud infrastructure, production support, incident resolution, security remediation, and operational readiness. The Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

* Participate in production support rotations and serve as a dependable technical resource for time-sensitive ordering escalations and cross-functional issue resolution.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build and enhance wholesale commerce portal capabilities across catalog, cart, checkout, order confirmation, account, product, and user-experience workflows that customers and internal teams depend on daily.

* Participate in resolving customer access issues and account setup problems, reducing friction in the wholesale commerce experience.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Design and develop scalable APIs, integrations, and supporting services using Go, Python, Node.js, and React/TypeScript that keep end-to-end business workflows reliable and extensible.
* Develop scalable data-processing solutions for product, catalog, account, and order workloads, including batch and asynchronous processing pipelines built on AWS services such as SQS/SNS, EventBridge, and Lambda.
* Contribute to application modernization efforts, including schema migration, platform refactoring, and the adoption of infrastructure-as-code practices via Terraform and GitHub Actions.
* Explore and apply emerging tools, patterns, and AI-enabled capabilities to continuously improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of commerce systems.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems through design, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing operational support across the full commerce application stack.
* Troubleshoot production issues using structured logs, metrics, distributed traces, application behavior, and data analysis; drive root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes rather than patches.
* Address application security and software supply-chain findings — including dependency vulnerabilities, authorization gaps, CI/CD hardening, and least-privilege access — with rigor and urgency.
* Reduce recurring production issues over time by improving monitoring, operational documentation, and the underlying reliability of data and integration workflows.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 3–6 years of professional software engineering experience with a strong track record delivering production software as an individual contributor, including full-stack ownership across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, data, and operational concerns.
* Proficiency with React and TypeScript for building customer-facing web applications, and proficiency in at least one backend language among Go, Python, or Node.js with willingness to work across the others.
* Production experience on AWS, including compute (ECS/EKS, Lambda), storage (S3), managed databases (RDS), and messaging services (SQS/SNS, EventBridge).
* Experience designing scalable APIs, data workflows, batch and asynchronous processing pipelines, and system integrations in a production environment.
* Strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills using logs, metrics, traces, and data, with the ability to implement durable fixes rather than short-term patches.
* Solid understanding of secure coding practices, dependency management, authorization models, secrets handling, and CI/CD security hardening.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively alongside product, business, platform, security, and support partners on ambiguous, end-to-end problems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in wholesale commerce, order management, catalog, product, inventory, or fulfillment domains.
* Exposure to Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) or the broader Salesforce commerce ecosystem.
* Experience with relational database design, query optimization, and schema migration at scale using PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Experience with messaging and event-driven integration patterns such as Pub/Sub, SQS/SNS, Kafka, or EventBridge.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK) and GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD tooling.
* Experience with application modernization, architecture, or platform migration initiatives.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in
**Hyderabad**
, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence IN-OFFICE SCHEDULE — Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday

description:
**Job Description**
You're ready to gain the skills and experience needed to grow within your role and advance your career — and we have the perfect software engineering opportunity for you.
  
  
As a Software Engineer II at JPMorganChase within the Consumer and community banking- Data technology, you are part of an agile team that works to enhance, design, and deliver the software components of the firm's state-of-the-art technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As an emerging member of a software engineering team, you execute software solutions through the design, development, and technical troubleshooting of multiple components within a technical product, application, or system, while gaining the skills and experience needed to grow within your role.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems
* Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
* Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
* Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture
* Contributes to software engineering communities of practice and events that explore new and emerging technologies
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
* Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Experience in developing, deploying and administering Java applications using JAVA, Spring Boot, Spring REST, Spring JPA and Hibernate and Web services technologies (REST).
* Working knowledge in any one of the Public Cloud Environments - Amazon Web Services (AWS S3, Lamda, EC2, ECS, RDS, etc.), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience with Distributed tracing, Monitoring tools, Micro service Architecture, Apache Kafka and Camunda.
* Experience in UI frameworks such as React JS, Angular JS, HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, XML, JQuery.
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Experience working in Application Development, Quality and Automation teams
* Experience in using SCM tools and frameworks such as Bitbucket, GitHub.
* Must have hands on the following build tools (or similar): IntelliJ/Eclipse, Jenkins, Maven, BitBucket/Git/Gitflow, JMeter/Blazemeter.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Have good understanding on DBMS concepts.
* Good knowledge of issue tracking systems, preferably Jira and Confluence
* Good to have experience in Terraform, Kubernetes and Snowflake.

title: Lead, Tech (Private Credit)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
The Private Credit Tech group at D. E. Shaw & Co. is looking for an experienced software developer to join our Tech team based in Hyderabad and Gurugram. This team is an extension of the firm's Private Credit business, based in the New York and London offices. The Private Credit business involves providing loans to private companies to facilitate capital for business growth, expansion, or refinancing existing debt. The Private Credit Tech team plays a critical role by developing the tools used by the business team for their daily workflows, working closely with the analysts to build analytical and operational tools that streamline pre- and post-trade business functions.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will collaborate directly with the product manager, the desk (based out of US and UK), and the Financial Research team based out of our India office to understand their workflows and requirements. You will design, build, and own full-stack web application platforms spanning post-trade analytics, underwriting and modeling, and deal-sourcing workflows, driving projects from requirements gathering and architecture through implementation, testing, and deployment. A core part of the role is developing a deep understanding of the desk's point of view so you can propose sound technical solutions to real business problems, while balancing pragmatic, quick-turnaround delivery with designs that endure as requirements evolve. You will take end-to-end ownership of the systems you build and hold a high bar for both quality and timeliness, championing clean coding practices, thoughtful design reviews, and robust, performance applications. You will actively use generative AI tools to accelerate your own productivity across prototyping, coding, testing, and troubleshooting, and look for opportunities to apply GAI to unlock new capabilities and streamline business workflows. You will also partner with other infrastructure teams to deliver solutions that scale and contribute to a strong engineering culture through knowledge sharing and mentorship — with the opportunity to grow into leading a small team by next year.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related technical field, with an exceptional foundation in algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented programming
* 5 years of software development experience, with strong hands-on programming experience in Python
* Front-end development experience, especially in ReactJS/Redux, with the ability to deliver full-stack web applications
* Good SQL skills to understand the existing infrastructure and build new tools
* Technical and architecture design experience, with the ability to translate vague, high-level requirements into well-structured, coherent designs
* Hands-on experience using generative AI / LLM-assisted developer tools to accelerate development and automation
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* The drive to learn about the finance domain and related analytics
* An interest in and aptitude for mentoring and leading a small team

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Prior experience in the finance domain, particularly in private credit, fixed income, or capital markets
* Experience owning projects end-to-end and driving them to completion

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/LeadTechPCJuly26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

title: Frontend Developer Intern
description:
Frontend Developer Intern

**Purple Business | Product & Engineering Team**

**Company:**
Purple Business

**Website:**
https://purplebusiness.in

**Position:**
Frontend Developer Intern

**Department:**
Software Engineering & Product Development

**Location:**
Remote

**Work Type:**
Internship | Flexible Working Hours

**Compensation:**
Unpaid Internship (No Fixed Stipend)

**Internship Duration:**
To be mutually agreed

**Reporting To:**
Technical Leads & Founding Team

About Purple Business

Purple Business is an emerging AI-powered business growth platform designed to help small businesses grow through intelligent marketing, advertising, customer insights, AI-powered automation, and business growth recommendations.

We're building a platform where small business owners can access powerful AI capabilities without needing to navigate complicated marketing dashboards or manage multiple software tools.

We're looking for a passionate, proactive, and technically curious
**Frontend Developer Intern**
to join our engineering team and contribute to building intuitive, responsive, and high-performance user experiences.

You'll collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend engineers, AI engineers, and technical leads to transform product ideas and Figma designs into functional, production-quality interfaces.

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Frontend Development

1. Develop responsive, interactive, and visually polished web interfaces using modern frontend technologies.
2. Convert Figma designs into functional, pixel-accurate frontend implementations.
3. Build reusable components, layouts, navigation systems, forms, and interactive UI elements.
4. Implement smooth animations, transitions, micro-interactions, and engaging user experiences.
5. Ensure consistent styling, responsive behavior, and design quality across different devices and screen sizes.
6. Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-structured frontend code.

2. Website & Product Development

1. Contribute to the development and improvement of Purple Business's website, landing pages, and web-based product interfaces.
2. Build interactive sections, business dashboards, onboarding experiences, and other product components.
3. Develop engaging product demonstrations and AI-powered interface experiences.
4. Collaborate with designers to implement new features and improve existing user journeys.
5. Optimize website performance, loading speed, accessibility, and mobile responsiveness.
6. Support website conversion optimization through improved forms, calls to action, and user experience.

3. Backend & AI Integration

1. Collaborate with backend developers to integrate REST APIs and other application services.
2. Connect frontend interfaces with business data, authentication systems, and relevant backend functionality.
3. Work with AI engineers to integrate AI-powered features into user-facing experiences.
4. Build interfaces for AI chat, recommendations, generated content, automation controls, and interactive workflows.
5. Implement appropriate loading states, error handling, notifications, and user feedback mechanisms.
6. Ensure smooth communication between frontend components and backend services.

4. UI/UX Collaboration & Product Quality

1. Work closely with the UI/UX design team to understand product requirements and visual specifications.
2. Participate in discussions around usability, component behavior, interaction patterns, and user experience improvements.
3. Suggest improvements to interface design based on technical feasibility and frontend best practices.
4. Maintain visual consistency through reusable components and design systems.
5. Test frontend functionality across common browsers, devices, and screen sizes.
6. Identify and fix UI bugs, layout inconsistencies, and performance issues.

5. Engineering Collaboration & Task Management

1. Collaborate with frontend developers, backend engineers, AI engineers, QA testers, and project managers.
2. Work with the project management team to organize and track development tasks using Trello or similar tools.
3. Break assigned features into smaller development tasks with clear deliverables.
4. Regularly communicate development progress, challenges, dependencies, and blockers.
5. Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and mutually scheduled engineering meetings.
6. Use Git and GitHub for version control, collaboration, and code management.

6. AI-Assisted Development & Engineering Productivity

1. Explore AI-assisted development tools such as ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, and other approved coding assistants.
2. Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate development, debugging, testing, and documentation.
3. Experiment with modern frontend libraries, frameworks, and implementation techniques.
4. Review and validate AI-generated code before integrating it into the codebase.
5. Identify opportunities to improve development efficiency, frontend architecture, and reusable components.

Required Skills

* Good understanding of
  **HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript**
  .
* Familiarity with
  **React.js**
  and modern component-based frontend development.
* Basic understanding of responsive design and mobile-first development.
* Ability to translate Figma designs into working interfaces.
* Familiarity with REST APIs and frontend-backend integration.
* Basic knowledge of Git and GitHub.
* Understanding of frontend debugging and browser developer tools.
* Strong attention to detail and interest in building polished user experiences.
* Willingness to learn, experiment, and collaborate with a technical team.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with
  **Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS**
  .
* Familiarity with component libraries and modern frontend UI frameworks.
* Understanding of web performance optimization, SEO, and accessibility.
* Experience building dashboards, SaaS interfaces, or AI-powered applications.
* Familiarity with frontend testing tools.
* Basic understanding of authentication, state management, and API integration.
* Exposure to Flutter or mobile application development.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools.

Prior professional experience is not mandatory. Personal projects, GitHub repositories, hackathon projects, and demonstrable frontend development skills will be considered.

What You'll Learn & Gain

As a Frontend Developer Intern at Purple Business, you'll have opportunities to:

1. **Real-World Product Development:**
   Work on actual product features and web experiences being developed for small business customers.
2. **Modern Frontend Engineering:**
   Gain practical experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, reusable components, and modern web development practices.
3. **UI/UX Implementation:**
   Learn how professional design teams translate ideas into Figma designs and how developers turn those designs into working interfaces.
4. **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
   Work with frontend developers, backend engineers, AI engineers, QA testers, and UI/UX designers.
5. **AI-Powered Product Development:**
   Gain exposure to building interfaces for AI assistants, automated workflows, content generation, and business intelligence.
6. **Backend Integration:**
   Develop experience connecting frontend interfaces with APIs, databases, and application services.
7. **Software Engineering Practices:**
   Learn Git workflows, code reviews, debugging, technical documentation, and collaborative development.
8. **AI-Assisted Coding:**
   Explore modern AI development tools and learn how to use them to improve engineering productivity.
9. **Startup & Product Exposure:**
   Understand how an emerging AI startup designs, develops, tests, and launches a software product.
10. **Career & Technical Growth:**
    Build your portfolio, strengthen your development skills, receive feedback from technical leads, and gain experience that can support future software engineering opportunities.

Key Expected Deliverables

* Responsive frontend pages and interfaces implemented from approved designs.
* Reusable and maintainable UI components.
* Functional API integrations for assigned features.
* Improvements to website speed, responsiveness, accessibility, and usability.
* Bug fixes and quality improvements across existing interfaces.
* Clear technical documentation and updated Trello tasks.
* Regular progress updates and effective coordination with the engineering team.

Internship Compensation & Future Opportunities

**This is an unpaid internship. No fixed monthly stipend or salary is currently offered.**

Purple Business is in its early product development and growth stage.

We intend to provide hands-on learning opportunities, practical project experience, technical mentorship, and exposure to building a real AI-powered product.

As Purple Business grows through funding or sustainable subscription revenue, there may be opportunities to transition into paid internships or full-time frontend engineering positions.

The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.

Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements.

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

**Full Stack Application Engineering**




+ End-to-end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend expertise using .NET / Java / Node.js / Python, with clean architecture, domain-driven design, and API-first principles
+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security

**AI Driven Application Development**

* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) - enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.
* Strong experience modernizing application landscapes using GitHub Copilot‑assisted approaches, including rapid codebase comprehension, dependency analysis, large‑scale refactoring, and migration to cloud‑native and AI‑enabled architectures.
* Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the entire SDLC, from solutioning and scaffolding through CI/CD automation, test generation, production readiness, and operational excellence.
* Ability to coach and enable teams and customers on effective Copilot usage patterns, prompt strategies, and safe AI‑assisted engineering practices in enterprise environments.
* Apply Responsible AI principles across design and delivery, incorporating security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls into production‑grade engineering workflows.

**AI-Enabled Application Development**

* Ability to translate business scenarios into production‑grade AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and custom ML models, with hands‑on delivery of RAG architectures leveraging Azure AI Search, vector databases, enterprise data grounding, and integration patterns.
* Strong expertise in prompt engineering, context management, grounding strategies, and LLM integration for copilots, conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, and decision‑support applications.
* Proven experience designing and implementing single‑agent and multi‑agent AI systems, including task boundaries, tool invocation, memory management, collaboration, delegation, and coordination, using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Deep understanding of agentic workflows, combining LLM reasoning with external tools, APIs, and enterprise data sources, alongside agent lifecycle management - planning, execution, retries, failure handling, and human‑in‑the‑loop patterns.
* Designs enterprise‑ready AI solutions with built‑in observability and operational excellence, including telemetry, prompt tracing, agent behavior logging, model metrics, experimentation, drift monitoring, and cost/performance optimization, while applying Responsible AI principles across security, privacy, governance, and compliance - balancing speed, quality, and enterprise constraints at scale.

**Cloud-Native Architecture (Azure)**




+ Deep experience designing cloud‑native, PaaS‑first solutions on Azure, prioritizing managed services over IaaS to improve scalability, resilience, security, and operational efficiency.
+ Proven expertise in architecting and delivering solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, AKS, Azure Functions, and API Management, selecting the right compute model based on workload characteristics and business needs.
+ Strong working knowledge of identity, security, and networking architectures, including Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault integration, private endpoints, and VNET‑integrated application deployments.
+ Design and implementation of architectures that support high availability, horizontal scalability, disaster recovery, and fault tolerance, including multi‑region deployment patterns and resiliency strategies.
+ Experience in cost‑aware architecture design, applying cost optimization strategies such as right‑sizing, autoscaling, consumption‑based services, and proactive cost governance.
+ Apply Microsoft Well‑Architected Framework principles across reliability, security, performance efficiency, operational excellence, and cost optimization, incorporating architecture reviews and continuous improvement into delivery.
+ Hands‑on experience building cloud‑ready landing patterns, integrating application architectures with enterprise networking, security baselines, and platform standards.

**DevOps, Platform & Developer Productivity**




+ Strong expertise in designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, enabling automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows across environments.
+ Proven hands‑on experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) using Bicep, ARM, and Terraform, leveraging GitHub Copilot to scaffold modules, generate templates, and propose secure configurations aligned with enterprise standards.
+ Deep understanding of observability and reliability engineering, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLOs, and proactive alerting for production systems.
+ Demonstrated ability to enhance developer productivity and delivery velocity through inner‑source practices, reusable components, reference implementations, accelerators, and automation.
+ Experience embedding DevSecOps practices into delivery pipelines, including secure coding checks, dependency scanning, secrets management, policy enforcement, and compliance validation.
+ Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the DevOps lifecycle, including authoring pipeline definitions, generating runbooks and release notes, assisting with PR summaries, and accelerating troubleshooting and incident response.
+ Strong grasp of platform engineering principles, building paved‑road solutions and self‑service capabilities that balance speed, governance, and operational excellence.
+ Ability to continuously improve engineering throughput, quality, and system reliability, while maintaining enterprise security and compliance expectations.

**Solutioning, Pre-Sales & Technical Leadership**




+ Lead technical solutioning, estimations, and support architecture design during pre-sales and delivery shaping
+ Translate business outcomes into clear architecture, execution plans, and risk mitigation strategies
+ Influence technical direction across multiple teams and engagements
+ Act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal leadership

+ Ability to go from whiteboard to production with minimal friction

+ Outcome‑driven engineering focused on business impact, not activity

* Accessibility & Inclusive Design: Champion WCAG accessibility standards and inclusive design best practices, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and seamless usability across all devices.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Ownership: Partner closely with UX designers, product managers, and backend engineers to influence technical solutions and deliver end-to-end features with high autonomy.

* Practical experience using Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent to improve software development workflows
* Experience integrating an application with an LLM or AI-powered API is a strong plus.
* Frameworks & State Architecture: Proven track record architecting scalable applications using React, Angular, or Vue, coupled with robust state management solutions (e.g., Redux, MobX, Context API, NgRx, or equivalent).
* Design Systems & Visual Craft: Strong experience building and contributing to reusable component libraries or design systems, paired with a relentless eye for responsive design and pixel-perfect implementation.
* Performance Optimization: Demonstrated expertise in front-end performance profiling and optimization, including code splitting, lazy loading, rendering efficiency, caching strategies, and bundle minimization.

* Problem-Solving & Collaboration: Strong analytical, debugging, and cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to independently solve complex technical challenges alongside design, product, and engineering partners.

title: Senior Manager, App Dev & Support
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Senior Technical Architect (Application Modernization)**
We are seeking a visionary Technical Architect with a deep background in Application Modernization to lead a critical digital transformation. This role is focused on deconstructing a legacy 2-tier architecture and rebuilding it into a scalable, high-performance N-tier system.
  
  
You will be the bridge between the past and the future—moving our logic out of SQL stored procedures and migrating our legacy C# frontend into a modern, responsive React/Redux ecosystem.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Architectural Strategy: Define the roadmap for migrating a monolithic 2-tier application (Client/Server) to a decoupled, N-tier architecture.
* Legacy Deconstruction: Analyze legacy C# codebases and complex SQL stored procedures to identify business logic for extraction.
* Modernization Execution: Lead the shift of business logic from the database layer into a dedicated C#/.NET Business Logic Layer (BLL) or Microservices.
* Frontend Leadership: Direct the transition from legacy UI to a modern React.js frontend, utilizing Redux for robust state management using Vite, Material UI, Redux Toolkit, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS.
* Ensure cross-browser compatibility, visual consistency, and WCAG accessibility compliance.
* API Design: Architect and implement secure, RESTful APIs that serve as the communication backbone between the new frontend and the re-engineered backend.
* Technical Governance: Establish coding standards, design patterns (e.g., Repository, Unit of Work), and CI/CD pipelines tailored for modernization projects.

**Technical Requirements**
Category Requirements Modernization Proven experience moving logic from Stored Procedures to Application Code (Refactoring the "Smart Database" anti-pattern). Frontend Expert-level proficiency in React.js, Redux / Redux Toolkit, Vite, Material UI, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS and modern CSS frameworks (Bootstrap). Backend Strong mastery of C# and .NET (6/7/8/9+), specifically in building Web APIs and Service Layers (must have strong hands-on experience in RestSharp, Dapper, Fluent Validations etc.). Database Deep understanding of SQL Server; ability to read/debug complex legacy T-SQL and optimize new schemas. Architecture Solid grasp of N-tier architecture, Dependency Injection, and Microservices patterns. Cloud/Containerization Expert-level proficiency in Cloud (Azure), Docker and Kubernetes. Cache Mechanism Strong mastery in Redis for Cache Management
  
  
**Experience & Qualifications**

* Modernization Veteran: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5+ years specifically leading Legacy-to-Modern migration projects.
* The "2-to-N" Specialist: Demonstrated success in breaking down 2-tier "Fat Client" or "Fat DB" systems into modular N-tier environments.
* Strategic Thinker: Ability to balance "perfect" architecture with business continuity.
* Communication: Ability to explain technical debt and architectural ROI to stakeholders who may only see the UI changes.
* Industry certifications would definitely be considered.

Conduent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, gender identity, gender expression, sex/gender, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, use of a guide dog or service animal, military/veteran status, citizenship status, basis of genetic information, or any other group protected by law.

Complete the form and then email it as an attachment to FTADAAA@conduent.com. You may also click here to access Conduent's ADAAA Accommodation Policy.

title: Application Engineer - III
description:
Provides advanced level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases, under general direction.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an Application Engineer with strong software development experience in Python, TypeScript, and API development to support emerging Agentic AI initiatives. Candidates having experience in UI Path and UI path agent is good to have. The role involves working closely with business and technology teams to understand problem statements, evaluate suitable AI tools, and guide solution design across a platform-agnostic environment. The ideal candidate should have exposure to LLMs, agent development, prompt engineering, AI workflows, automation, AWS, and data concepts. Experience with UiPath Agent Builder, Amazon Bedrock, QuickSight, or financial services domain knowledge will be an added advantage. This role offers an opportunity to work on real business use cases in a fast-evolving AI space.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.
* Translates technical specifications into code for complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. Writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. Employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner certification preferred.
* Adobe Experience Manager, AWS Cloud background.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
* Strong Software Development background with hands-on development experience, including API development, Python(Preferred), and TypeScript (5-7 years).
* Experience with LLM and Agent Development.
* Strong prompt engineering skills with an understanding of how agents and memory management work.
* Experience with AI workflows and automation.
* Sound understanding of data concepts and AWS.
* Experience in UI Path Platform and UIPath Agent Builder background
* Python is mandatory.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Specialist, Infrastructure Engineering
description:
****Job Description****
**Specialist, Infrastructure Engineering**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
****Role Overview****
The Portal Developer is responsible for maintaining the IT Automation portal design and code integrity, adhering to all standards and policies used within our company. They will assist other engineers and developers in the use of open protocols and platform APIs, along with automation vendor platforms, for supporting the design and development and integrating of IT solutions with the automation platform(s). Working with IT Automation and other Platform architects to maintain and evolve the Automation Reference Architecture. The role works with internal technical specialists, architects, and external service providers to support the future direction of IT Automation. The incumbent will support the implementation of IT Automation products and provide subject-matter expertise to all IT Automation developers.
  
  
****What Will You Do In This Role****

* Manage the design, procurement, installation, upgrading, operation, control, maintenance, and effective use of specific technology services.
* Follow standard approaches and established design patterns to create new designs for systems or system components. Apply agreed standards and tools to achieve a well-engineered result.
* Carry out and also improve system software development and maintenance tasks by updating the product design to automate routine system administration tasks using standard tools and software development practices.
* Contribute to identification and prioritized adoption of Technology Engineering community practices within the products where you work.
* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and the Product manager.
* Participate in Product planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with Product goals.

****What Should You Have****

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 3-7 years of hands-on experience.
* 5 years and above of relevant experience.
* Working knowledge or subject matter expertise with ReactJS, TypeScript, NodeJS, and frameworks/systems (Git).
* Experience with software/application type monolith with NodeJS backend and AngularJS/ReactJS front end.
* Previous experience developing ServiceNow software solutions using JavaScript, Jelly, Web Services, MYSQL, XML, HTML and CSS.
* Proficiency with ServiceNow Flow Designer and development of workflows, custom web services, custom notifications, assessments, custom applications.
* Knowledge of building out ServiceNow CMS (ESS – Employee Self Service Portal).
* Strong knowledge of Agile delivery & practice.
* Experience with databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL or other).
* Good communication skills.
* Flexibility to work a shift overlapping part of the US Work Day.
* Previous experience with the development of automated testing solutions.
* Working knowledge of AWS serverless architecture including the use of Lambdas and step functions.
* AWS or ServiceNow certifications are a plus.

****Preferred Skills****
**Primary Skills**
**(Must have)**

* Strong hands-on experience in React.js, TypeScript, and Node.js.
* Experience with Git and version control best practices.
* Experience in Full Stack Application Development.
* Working knowledge of Cloud Technologies (AWS preferred; Azure, GCP, or equivalent cloud platforms acceptable).
* Experience working with Databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL, or similar.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Ability to design, develop, troubleshoot, and maintain scalable web applications.
* Working knowledge of Automated Testing Solutions, such as Playwright.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills in a global team environment.

**Secondary Skills**
**(Nice to have)**

* Experience with ServiceNow Development.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow Flow Designer and workflow development.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Front-End (Angular) | Global Employer Services Technology Center
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the front-end engineering team within Deloitte Tax in India’s Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC). You will design, build, and support responsive, accessible, high-performance user interfaces for the GES workflow platform using Angular and TypeScript, integrating with REST APIs, microservices, and workflow services to give business users a fast, intuitive way to manage their work.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings 8 to 12 years of hands-on front-end development experience, with deep expertise in Angular. You have strong engineering fundamentals, work well independently with minimal supervision, and collaborate and communicate effectively with your own team, UX designers, backend and product teams, business users, and global delivery partners.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Pega Constellation architecture is a significant differentiator for this role. Experience with other workflow and low-code platforms (such as ServiceNow, Appian, or Salesforce), as well as AI engineering and AWS cloud technologies, is also a plus.
  
  
**Key job responsibilities:**

* Own the design and delivery of small to medium complexity front-end modules end to end, from technical design and estimation through development, testing, deployment support, and production support.
* Build user interfaces with Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, HTML5, and CSS3 / SCSS.
* Create reusable components and shared UI libraries aligned to the product’s design system.
* Integrate with REST APIs and microservices, handling authentication, asynchronous data flows, and error scenarios.
* Build workflow-centric experiences such as worklists, case and task views, dynamic forms, approvals, and dashboards.
* Deliver responsive, cross-browser, and accessible (WCAG) interfaces.
* Build and extend user experiences on Pega Constellation using DX APIs, the Constellation design system, and custom components, where applicable.
* Write automated unit and end-to-end tests, and analyze and resolve production defects, driving fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Conduct code and design reviews for peer engineers, and ensure adherence to engineering standards, CI/CD practices, and front-end security requirements.
* Improve application performance (for example lazy loading, bundle size, and rendering efficiency), stability, and maintainability.
* Contribute to front-end architecture discussions, particularly for workflow experiences, reusable components, and integration with platform services.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, Architects, Technical Program Managers, Engineering Managers, business stakeholders, and global delivery teams.
* Mentor and coach junior engineers within the team.
* Take ownership of assigned modules and workstreams, solving problems independently with minimal supervision.
* Support modernization and innovation efforts, including AI-assisted code generation, AI-enabled automation, and AWS cloud-native services, where applicable.

Location: Hyderabad
  
  
Shift Timings: 11:00 AM -8:00 PM
  
  
**Education/Background:**

* UG: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or in a related discipline.
* PG: Master’s degree in a relevant field is preferred, but not mandatory.

**Key skills desired:**

* 8 to 12 years of hands-on front-end development experience for enterprise applications, with strong recent experience in Angular (current versions) and TypeScript.
* Strong working knowledge of RxJS and a state management approach such as NgRx.
* Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3 / SCSS, and responsive, accessible UI design.
* Experience integrating front-end applications with REST APIs and microservices.
* Strong understanding of component design, debugging, browser performance optimization, and production support.
* Experience with automated testing (for example Jasmine / Karma, Jest, Cypress, or Playwright), source control, and CI/CD practices.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, within small agile teams, and across larger distributed teams.
* Hands-on experience with Pega Constellation architecture, including DX APIs, the Constellation design system, and building custom components. This is a strong differentiator.
* Experience with other Pega UI approaches, and Pega certification (for example CSA, CSSA, or CPLSA / LSA), is a plus.
* Experience with other workflow or low-code platforms such as ServiceNow, Appian, or Salesforce, particularly for case management or enterprise workflow use cases.
* Experience with micro-frontend architectures and building or maintaining design systems.
* Familiarity with Node.js, or with backend technologies such as .NET, to collaborate effectively on API design.
* Exposure to AI-driven engineering or AI-enabled solution development.
* Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native development patterns.
* Experience with containerization and modern engineering practices.

title: Senior UX Engineer
description:
**About The opportunity**

Demandbase is building toward an AI-first future, where intelligent, agentic experiences help customers understand what matters, make decisions, and take action faster.

We are looking for a Senior UX Engineer to help make that future real.

This is a UX role with deep engineering capability, not a traditional frontend engineering role. You will start with the customer problem and use design, code, and AI to turn ideas into exceptional production experiences.

You will sit at the intersection of Design, Product, AI, and Engineering, helping us move from concept to high-quality implementation faster. Beyond building experiences yourself, you will create the workflows, patterns, tools, and guardrails that help our Design organization get better experiences into the product with greater speed and fidelity.

You will also help establish UX Engineering as a new function at Demandbase, bringing UX culture and the voice of the customer closer to our India Product and Engineering teams while partnering deeply with our US-based Design organization.

**What you'll do**

* Build polished, production-ready Demandbase AI experiences from concept through launch.
* Start with customer needs and translate design intent into thoughtful, high-quality working experiences.
* Partner closely with Design, Product, AI, and Engineering to explore and ship new agentic interaction patterns.
* Create workflows that help designers move from ideas and prototypes into production more effectively.
* Close gaps between design intent and implementation through hands-on development and structured pre- and post-launch reviews.
* Identify experience-quality issues earlier and help teams prioritize improvements faster.
* Use AI-assisted development extensively to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, and iteration.
* Create reusable components, patterns, tools, and guardrails that improve quality across teams.
* Bring strong UX craft and customer advocacy into the India Product and Engineering organization.
* Teach and mentor designers and engineers, helping establish durable AI-enabled ways of working.
* Help define what great UX Engineering looks like at Demandbase.

**What we're looking for**

* Exceptional UX and product judgment, with a strong understanding of customer workflows and needs.
* Strong frontend engineering skills and experience shipping complex web applications to production.
* Ability to move fluidly between design thinking, interaction design, prototyping, and production code.
* Deep experience with modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript.
* Highly proficient with AI-assisted development tools and comfortable using AI throughout the development lifecycle.
* A builder mindset: curious, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated to make ideas real.
* Experience creating reusable systems and patterns, not only one-off implementations.
* Strong attention to usability, accessibility, performance, interaction details, and product quality.
* Strong communication and influence across Design, Product, and Engineering.
* Experience working effectively across distributed and global teams.
* A desire to help other designers and engineers become more effective builders.

**What will make you stand out**

* You have built AI-native, conversational, or agentic product experiences.
* You can show work where understanding the customer changed what you ultimately built.
* You have personally taken an experience from concept or Figma into production code.
* You have helped establish a UX Engineering, Design Engineering, or Design Systems practice.
* You actively experiment with AI development workflows and can explain where AI helps, where it fails, and how you validate its output.
* You have created tools or workflows that made an entire design or engineering team more effective.
* You care as much about the shipped customer experience as the original design.

**What success looks like**

**You will help Demandbase:**

* Ship AI experiences faster with a higher quality bar.
* Catch gaps between design intent and implementation earlier.
* Build reusable interaction patterns for emerging AI experiences.
* Give designers better ways to get their work into production.
* Strengthen the partnership between Design, Product, and Engineering across the US and India.
* Bring a stronger voice of the customer into the India organization.

Most importantly, you will help ensure that as Demandbase becomes more AI-first, the experience becomes more useful, understandable, trustworthy, and human.
